reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 11 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 82 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 205 and 253 total points.

analyst.text: Damian Lillard makes his first trip back to Milwaukee since tearing his Achilles there, saying 'I'm not going to limp out of here', after warning Giannis that 'the grass isn't always greener'. The Bucks are 1-14 with 11 straight losses, the worst 15-game start in franchise history, and come in the night after Giannis beat them in Miami. Deni Avdija (foot) is questionable for Portland. The emotional edge and the mood both lean clearly towards Portland.
